scripts.build: npm run build -w @judo/engine && npm run build -w @judo/api && npm run build -w @judo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @judo/engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @judo/engine && npm run test -w @judo/engine && npm run test -w @judo/web && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @judo/api && node --test scripts/api-regression.test.mjs scripts/assignment-regression.test.mjs scripts/roster-regression.test.mjs scripts/roster-name-regression.test.mjs scripts/athlete-regression.test.mjs scripts/access-regression.test.mjs scripts/clock-correction-regression.test.mjs scripts/scheduling-regression.test.mjs scripts/protocol-regression.test.mjs scripts/pdf-pagination-regression.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @judo/engine && npm run build -w @judo/api && npm run start -w @judo/api
scripts.test:rehearsal: npm run build -w @judo/engine && npm run build -w @judo/api && node --env-file=apps/api/.env scripts/rehearsal.mjs
scripts.test:protocols: npm run build -w @judo/engine && npm run build -w @judo/api && node --env-file=apps/api/.env scripts/protocol-integration.mjs
